CustomField.description: DeveloperName of the DocusignConfiguration__mdt record to authenticate with. Named here rather than hardcoded as OIC_DPGDocuSignDocumentAPIHelper does, so pointing at a demo account later is a setting change and not a deploy. Note that both records in this org currently point at the live production account. Must also be added to the SELECT in ADHA_JourneyController.settings() or it reads as null.
CustomField.label: Docusign Config Name
